cards.ex: Even when everyone else doubted him, she stuck by him.
cards.exUz: Hatto boshqalar unga ishonmaganda ham, u unga sodiq qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham kimnidir qo'llab-quvvatlash, unga sodiq qolish.

cards.ex: I can't believe he stabbed me in the back after all I did for him.
cards.exUz: Men unga bunchalik yordam berganimdan keyin u menga xiyonat qilishiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchga kirib, orqadan xiyonat qilmoq, pand berish.

cards.ex: He betrayed her trust by revealing her secret.
cards.exUz: U uning sirini oshkor qilib, uning ishonchini suiiste'mol qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ishonchini yo'qotish, unga xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: I don't trust her; she's very two-faced.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonmayman; u juda ikkiyuzlamachi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil odamga har xil munosabatda bo'lish, riyokorlik.

cards.ex: The knights swore loyalty to their king.
cards.exUz: Ritsarlar o'z shohlariga sodiqlikka qasamyod qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimga yoki nimagadir sodiq bo'lishga qasamyod qilish.

cards.ex: He's a fair-weather friend; he's only around when things are good.
cards.exUz: U vaqtinchalik do'st; u faqat ishlar yaxshi bo'lganda yonimda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi kunlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: He ratted his friend out to the police to save himself.
cards.exUz: U o'zini qutqarish uchun do'stini politsiyaga sotdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir politsiyaga yoki boshqa rahbarlarga sotmoq.

cards.ex: He's playing both sides to see who wins.
cards.exUz: U kim g'alaba qozonishini bilish uchun ikki tomonni o'ynamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomonning ham manfaatlarini ko'zlab ish tutish.

cards.ex: If you cross him, you'll regret it.
cards.exUz: Agar siz unga xiyonat qilsangiz, afsus qilasiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir g'azabini keltirish, xiyonat qilish oqibatida jazolanish.

cards.ex: Don't turn your back on your family in their time of need.
cards.exUz: Muhtoj paytda oilangizdan yuz o'girmang.
cards.uzDef: Kimga yoki nimagadir yordam berishni to'xtatish, yuz o'girish.

cards.ex: I will always stand by you, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, men har doim sizni qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham kimnidir qo'llab-quvvatlash, yordam berish.

cards.ex: I'm always in your corner; you can count on me.
cards.exUz: Men har doim sizning himoyachingizman; menga ishonishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir tarafdori bo'lish, uni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: You have to be true to yourself and your beliefs.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizga va e'tiqodingizga sodiq bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z ideallari, so'zlari va odamlarga sodiq qolish.

cards.ex: He double-crossed his partners and stole all the money.
cards.exUz: U sheriklariga ikki karra xiyonat qildi va barcha pulni o'g'irladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro kelishuvni buzish, xiyonat ustiga xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: He sold out his friends for a promotion.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilish uchun do'stlarini sotib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ishonchini suiiste'mol qilib, manfaat uchun sotish.

cards.ex: New citizens take an oath of allegiance to the country.
cards.exUz: Yangi fuqarolar mamlakatga sodiqlik qasamyodini qabul qiladilar.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakatga, tashkilotga yoki shaxsga sodiqlikni bildiruvchi qasamyod.

cards.ex: He broke faith with his supporters when he changed his policies.
cards.exUz: U siyosatini o'zgartirganda, tarafdorlarining ishonchini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir xafa qilish, ishonchini yo'qotish, xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: He was branded a turncoat for switching political parties.
cards.exUz: U siyosiy partiyalarni almashtirgani uchun xoin deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Bir tomondan boshqa tomonga o'tib ketgan odam, xoin.

cards.ex: Loyalty is a virtue that is highly valued in our family.
cards.exUz: Sodiqlik - oilamizda yuqori baholanadigan fazilat.
cards.uzDef: Sodiqlik yaxshi xislat ekanligini ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: His wavering loyalty made it difficult to trust him.
cards.exUz: Uning o'zgaruvchan sodiqligi unga ishonishni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz yoki o'zgaruvchan sodiqlik holati.

cards.ex: The scandal was a major breach of trust between the company and its customers.
cards.exUz: Bu janjal kompaniya va uning mijozlari o'rtasidagi ishonchni buzish edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ishonchini suiiste'mol qilish, xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: His double-dealing eventually caught up with him.
cards.exUz: Uning ikkitalik o'yini oxir-oqibat fosh bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirincha aldash, ikki tomonga ham yolg'on gapirish.

cards.ex: We've been friends through thick and thin.
cards.exUz: Biz qiyin va oson kunlarda ham do'st bo'lib kelganmiz.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin va oson kunlarda ham birga bo'lish.

cards.ex: Even when pressured, she stuck to her guns and defended her beliefs.
cards.exUz: Bosimga qaramay, u o'z fikrida qat'iy turdi va e'tiqodini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrlaridan voz kechmaslik, qat'iy turish.

cards.ex: He deserted his team during the most important game.
cards.exUz: U jamoasini eng muhim o'yinda tashlab ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qiyin vaziyatda yolg'iz tashlab ketish.

cards.ex: Loyalty runs deep in this family; they always support each other.
cards.exUz: Bu oilada sodiqlik juda chuqur; ular doim bir-birlarini qo'llab-quvvatlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va uzoq davom etadigan sodiqlik.

cards.ex: He's a trustworthy person; you can rely on him.
cards.exUz: U ishonchli odam; unga ishonishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ishonish mumkin bo'lgan odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: His nervous behavior gave him away.
cards.exUz: Uning asabiy harakatlari uni sotib qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir sirini yoki haqiqatini oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: He broke his promise to help me move.
cards.exUz: U menga ko'chishga yordam berish haqidagi va'dasini buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Berilgan va'dani bajarmaslik.

cards.ex: He felt like his boss was giving him a loyalty test.
cards.exUz: U boshlig'i unga sodiqlik sinovini o'tkazayotgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir sodiqligini tekshirish maqsadida qilingan sinov.
